message: A grocery item can now declare which general ingredient it's a variety of, like white onion for onion. Set "Variety of" on the item, and a recipe line naming the general ingredient counts as covered while you have any declared variety: shopping suggestions, meal shortfall tasks and use-up recipes all read it. A line naming a specific variety still matches only that one, and the rest of the family shows up as a "you have white onion" note the way substitutes do
